experiences.title: Research Experience
experiences.description: Published research on **Gender Abusive Language Detection in Bengali Using Machine Learning Algorithms** in the 2nd International Conference on Big Data, IoT and Machine Learning, Springer, 2023. This research focuses on developing machine learning models to identify and classify abusive language patterns in Bengali text, contributing to safer digital communication platforms.

experiences.title: Leadership Development
experiences.description: Selected among the **Top 15 Female STEM talents nationwide**. Participated in an intensive leadership development program held at Banglalink Head Office, Gulshan-1, Dhaka. The program focused on developing technical leadership skills, mentorship capabilities, and professional growth in the technology sector.

experiences.title: Leadership Training
experiences.description: Completed leadership development program organized by the **Aspire Institute, founded at Harvard University**. Gained valuable insights into leadership principles, team management, and strategic thinking applicable to technology and research environments.

experiences.title: Professional Training
experiences.description: Completed multiple professional training programs including **Python (Django) Training** under RUET EDGE project, **Python Training with PCEP Certification (93% Score)**, and **LEDP Training in Web Design & Development**. These training programs enhanced technical skills in software development and web technologies.
